title: Audio resample phase at count
summary: Recovered read-only fastcall member at VA 0x5908d0. Starts at 16384; positive counts repeat wrapped 32-bit product addition and signed remainder by 32768. Nonpositive counts read no fields. Direct original disassembly and five callers establish register ABI and caller-owned phase stores.
test_description: Direct original oracle comparison for 2475 combinations of boundary factors/counts plus 2000 deterministic randomized cases. Includes signed extremes, product/addition overflow, remainder boundaries, zero and negative counts. Checks every byte of the partial state remains unchanged after each original and recovered call and checks result range.
known_limits: Field names describe arithmetic roles; full audio-state type and units remain unresolved.
Maximum positive count is not executed in tests; implementation retains original linear iteration.
No claim of matching machine code or whole-game audio validation.
